payload.task_text:
I want to set up a healthy eating program for my team. Please use our recipe database to find recipes from at least three different categories and create a comprehensive overview for the program.

First, create a Google Form called Dietary Preference Survey with a description about gathering team food preferences. Add a required single-choice (multiple choice) question asking "Which meal types do you prefer" with the options Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, and Snacks. Add a required single-choice (multiple choice) question asking "Which dietary restrictions apply to you" with the options Vegetarian, Vegan, Gluten-Free, Dairy-Free, and None. Add a required single-choice (multiple choice) question asking "How many home-cooked meals do you have per week" with the options 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, and 7 (a rating on a scale from 1 to 7). Add an optional text question asking "Are there any specific ingredients you want to avoid".

Then browse through the recipe collection and select at least six recipes representing at least three different categories. Create a Notion page titled Healthy Recipe Knowledge Base. The page should contain blocks for each selected recipe that list the recipe name, the category it belongs to, and a brief description of the recipe.

Also create an Excel file called Recipe_Overview.xlsx in my workspace. This file should have two sheets. The first sheet should be called Recipes and contain columns for Recipe_Name, Category, and Description, with one row for each of the selected recipes. The second sheet should be called Category Summary and show each category name and how many recipes you found in it: put the category name in the first column and the count in the second column, one row per category (do not add extra Total/合计 rows). All numeric values in this file (including the category counts) must be entered as plain literal numbers, not as Excel formulas.

Send an email to wellness.team@company.com with the subject Healthy Eating Program - Recipe Selection. The body should describe the initiative and mention the recipes selected.

Task-Solving Rationable with Sub-task Decomposition:
To solve this task efficiently, complete it directly in the main agent; do not dispatch sub-agents. Freeze the task-visible agent-workspace absolute path from the Visible Boundary/current working directory; never assume `/workspace`. Query exact categories `早餐`, `素菜`, and `主食` in one native-parallel response, select exactly two distinct suitable IDs per category, then retrieve only those six exact IDs in a second native-parallel response. Require six distinct source-backed `{recipe_id,chinese_name,english_name,category,description}` rows and freeze them once.

From those rows, start the independent form, Notion, workbook, and email branches in the same orchestration response. The main agent is the sole owner of each output: exactly one `Dietary Preference Survey` with the four questions/options/required flags in task order; exactly one `Healthy Recipe Knowledge Base` page with one explicit block per recipe; `<agent_workspace>/Recipe_Overview.xlsx` with only `Recipes(Recipe_Name,Category,Description)` and `Category Summary` containing exactly the three category rows with literal count `2` and no total row; and exactly one email to `wellness.team@company.com` with subject `Healthy Eating Program - Recipe Selection` naming all six recipes. Read the form, page, and workbook once and reconcile them to the frozen six rows. Do not search Sent mail or add writer/verification agents.

nodes.text:
Create and verify a Google Form titled "Dietary Preference Survey" with description stating it gathers team food preferences. Add these questions in order: (1) required multiple choice: "Which meal types do you prefer" options Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Snacks; (2) required multiple choice: "Which dietary restrictions apply to you" options Vegetarian, Vegan, Gluten-Free, Dairy-Free, None; (3) required multiple choice: "How many home-cooked meals do you have per week" options 1,2,3,4,5,6,7; (4) optional text: "Are there any specific ingredients you want to avoid". Return the form ID/link and verification of title, description, questions, choices, and required flags. This is an authorized external write. Do not perform any other task.
Create dietary survey

Browse the granted HowToCook recipe database and select exactly six reasonably healthy recipes spanning at least three different database categories. Retrieve enough detail to return for each: exact recipe name, exact category, and a concise 1-2 sentence factual description based on its ingredients/preparation. Aim for two recipes in each of three categories if practical so summary counts are clear. Do not write or mutate anything. Return a clean table and category counts, noting that these exact records will be used in a Notion page, Excel workbook, and email.
Select healthy recipes

Create and verify a Notion page titled "Healthy Recipe Knowledge Base". This is an authorized external write. The page must contain a clear block/section for each of the six recipes below, listing recipe name, category, and brief description exactly and consistently. Add a short intro if useful.

1) 凉拌豆腐的做法 | 素菜 | 豆腐焯水后沥干，以生抽、香油、蒜末和葱花调味，醋、糖及辣椒油均为可选。以豆腐为主体，做法简单且用油较少。
2) 凉拌黄瓜的做法 | 素菜 | 黄瓜拍碎切块，加入蒜末、醋、酱油、少量盐和蚝油腌制，最后拌入香油。全程无需煎炸。
3) 清蒸鲈鱼的做法 | 水产 | 整条鲈鱼搭配姜和香葱大火蒸熟，再淋蒸鱼豉油及少量热油。清蒸是主要烹调方式，主体食材和调味结构都较简单。
4) 白灼虾的做法 | 水产 | 活虾铺在洋葱和姜片上，加入料酒后加盖焖熟，并配以葱、蒜、酱油、香醋等制成的蘸料。虾本身不经油炸，蘸料可按需取用。
5) 小米粥的做法 | 汤 | 配方仅使用小米和水；小米下入沸水后先大火、再转中小火熬煮，并在过程中搅拌防止粘锅。
6) 紫菜蛋花汤的做法 | 汤 | 干紫菜泡发后入水煮开，再徐徐倒入蛋液，最后加入葱花和少量香油；虾仁或虾皮可选。配方以紫菜和鸡蛋为主。

Use an appropriate accessible workspace parent and return page ID/URL plus verification that all six sections and fields exist. Do not create unrelated resources.
Create recipe Notion page

Create and verify the Excel workbook at exactly `/workspace/dumps/kimi-code_gpt-5.6-sol/SingleUserTurn-howtocook-diet-gform-notion-excel/workspace/Recipe_Overview.xlsx`. It must have exactly the relevant two sheets named `Recipes` and `Category Summary` (remove/rename any default sheet as needed).

Recipes sheet columns in row 1: Recipe_Name, Category, Description. Rows 2-7 exactly:
凉拌豆腐的做法 | 素菜 | 豆腐焯水后沥干，以生抽、香油、蒜末和葱花调味，醋、糖及辣椒油均为可选。以豆腐为主体，做法简单且用油较少。
凉拌黄瓜的做法 | 素菜 | 黄瓜拍碎切块，加入蒜末、醋、酱油、少量盐和蚝油腌制，最后拌入香油。全程无需煎炸。
清蒸鲈鱼的做法 | 水产 | 整条鲈鱼搭配姜和香葱大火蒸熟，再淋蒸鱼豉油及少量热油。清蒸是主要烹调方式，主体食材和调味结构都较简单。
白灼虾的做法 | 水产 | 活虾铺在洋葱和姜片上，加入料酒后加盖焖熟，并配以葱、蒜、酱油、香醋等制成的蘸料。虾本身不经油炸，蘸料可按需取用。
小米粥的做法 | 汤 | 配方仅使用小米和水；小米下入沸水后先大火、再转中小火熬煮，并在过程中搅拌防止粘锅。
紫菜蛋花汤的做法 | 汤 | 干紫菜泡发后入水煮开，再徐徐倒入蛋液，最后加入葱花和少量香油；虾仁或虾皮可选。配方以紫菜和鸡蛋为主。

Category Summary row 1 headers: Category, Count. Rows 2-4: 素菜 | 2 ; 水产 | 2 ; 汤 | 2. Do not add any Total/合计 row. All numbers must be plain literal numeric values, not formulas. Apply clean readable formatting (header emphasis, wrap descriptions, sensible widths) without changing data. Re-open/read workbook to verify sheet names, exact data, numeric types/literal values, and absence of formulas/extra total row. Return path and verification results.
Build recipe workbook

Send an email to `wellness.team@company.com` with exact subject `Healthy Eating Program - Recipe Selection`. This is an authorized external write. The body should professionally describe the team healthy eating initiative, mention that a Dietary Preference Survey was created to gather meal preferences, dietary restrictions, home-cooked meal frequency, and ingredients to avoid, and list these six selected recipes with categories: 凉拌豆腐的做法（素菜）, 凉拌黄瓜的做法（素菜）, 清蒸鲈鱼的做法（水产）, 白灼虾的做法（水产）, 小米粥的做法（汤）, 紫菜蛋花汤的做法（汤）. Mention that they span three categories and will support varied healthy options. Include the Google Form link `https://docs.google.com/forms/d/8abfffd2-50da-494b-8c9e-14968c351dd9/viewform` for team responses. Do not attach files unless necessary, and do not email anyone else. Return send confirmation/message ID.
Email wellness team
